title.zh-TW: Muse 的 5 小時額度用完後持續更新，用量卡片顯示已用滿
title.en: Muse continues updating after 5-hour quota is exhausted, with usage card showing full

body.zh-TW: 平時頻繁使用 Muse 協作時，如果額度見底，你可能會打開 `usage` 查看剩餘狀況與重置時間。⟦跟看停車場入口的剩餘車位看板一樣，以前場內車輛停滿甚至超額借停時，計數器因為讀到破表數字而停止刷新，螢幕凍結在用滿前一刻並掛著過期提示；現在就算車位全滿，看板也會持續更新並清楚顯示客滿。⟧Muse 在 5 小時額度耗盡時，回報的使用率常會超過 100%（例如 104%）。以前 `usage` 會直接把這種大於 100% 的讀數丟掉。這導致卡片一直停留在低於 100% 的最後一次讀數，並掛著過期標籤（stale-age badge，標示資料多久未更新的標籤），直到 5 小時週期重置。現在卡片在 5 小時額度用完後仍會持續刷新，並清楚標示為已用滿，方便你隨時掌握最新狀態。
body.en: When frequently collaborating with Muse, if your quota runs low, you might open `usage` to check the remaining status and reset time. ⟦Think of the vacancy board at a parking lot entrance. Previously, when the lot was full or even overfilled with parked cars, the counter stopped updating because it read an off-the-charts number, freezing the screen right before full capacity with an expired notice. Now, even when all spaces are full, the board continues to update and clearly displays that the lot is full.⟧ Muse exhausts its 5-hour quota, the reported usage often exceeds 100% (such as 104%). Previously, `usage` would directly discard readings greater than 100%. This caused the card to remain stuck at the last reading below 100% with a stale-age badge (a label indicating how long data has not been updated) until the 5-hour cycle reset. Now, the card continues to refresh after the 5-hour quota is exhausted and clearly indicates that it is full, making it easy for you to track the latest status at any time.

items.original: **The Muse card stays current after a 5-hour window runs out.** Muse reports an exhausted window as more than 100% used (for example 104%), and `usage` threw those readings away. The card kept the last reading under 100% with a stale-age badge until the window reset; it now shows the window as full.
